def _standardize(train, test):
    (x, ref, lab, stratum) = (np.concatenate((train[k], test[k]), axis=0) for k in ('coupon_features_raw', 'ref_coupons', 'lab_id', 'stratum'))
    for group in np.unique(lab):
        mask = lab == group
        controls = ref[mask]
        offset = np.nanmedian(np.nanmean(controls, axis=0))
        scale = np.nanmedian(np.nanstd(controls, axis=0))
        x[mask] = (x[mask] - offset) / scale
    (_, inverse, counts) = np.unique(np.column_stack((lab, stratum)), axis=0, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    weight = (1.0 / counts[inverse]).reshape(-1, 1)
    observed = np.isfinite(x)
    fill = np.sum(weight * np.where(observed, x, 0), axis=0) / np.sum(weight * observed, axis=0)
    x = np.where(observed, x, fill)
    n = len(train['lab_id'])
    return (x[:n], x[n:])

def _stress_calibration(cal):
    raw = cal['bridge_raw']
    coefficients = np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack((raw, np.ones(len(raw)))), cal['true_channel_loads'], rcond=None)[0].sum(axis=1)
    return lambda bridge: bridge @ coefficients[:4] + coefficients[4]

def solve_batch(dataset: dict) -> dict:
    (train, test) = (dataset['train'], dataset['test'])
    (x_tr, x_te) = _standardize(train, test)
    stress = _stress_calibration(dataset['calibration_load_cells'])
    (dt, t) = (dataset['past_dt'], dataset['eval_times'])
    tr_design = _design(train, x_tr, stress, dt, t)
    (taus, theta) = _fit(tr_design, train['strain_curves_obs'] - train['strain_0'][:, None], train['instant_rate_obs'])
    (strain, rate) = _design(test, x_te, stress, dt, t)(taus)
    return {'estimated_taus': taus, 'hereditary_weights': theta, 'predicted_strain': test['strain_0'][:, None] + strain @ theta, 'initial_rate_pred': rate @ theta}
